fairCompetitionTable.semantics: rule 165 detailed_all=True diagnostic: every cheap-feasible candidate detailed-validated, feasible candidates with full D-2 score components so k1/k2 (and family) totals are comparable side by side; never a production mode

explanation.1_scorePricing: D-2 prices the measured family signature into the geometry group: geometry += 20.0*meanCurvature(rad/m) + 0.05*headingReversalCount + 0.02*hairpinRunCount (module constants in layout/search.py, chosen a priori as round numbers; never reverse-engineered so a particular family wins). Every SUCCESS case's winnerGeometry/winnerTotalScore drifts for this reason alone even where the winner is unchanged (WARPED-301, IRREGULAR), and the two new metric columns winnerMeanCurvatureRadPerM / winnerHairpinRuns populate everywhere.
explanation.2_proxyLowerBound: rule 165 corrective: the audited length-only cheap proxy missed the exhaustive winner on TABULAR/CUT_AND_FILL (cheap rank 40 of 62 shortlist-eligible) and GEOMETRY-STRESS (rank 22 of 26). The stage-3 proxy is now the cheap LOWER BOUND of the weighted total: w_dev*(lengthRatio + 0.5*meanAccess/reach) + w_geom*(unusedGrade + 0.5*turningFrac + maxAccess/reach + curvature/reversal/hairpin terms); the omitted access length, clearance headroom and geology are non-negative, so the bound is admissible for the final ranking. Additionally every declared family's best cheap-feasible candidate holds a shortlist slot (bound stays 12; the proxy tail is displaced).
explanation.3_tabularWinnerChange: TABULAR-REFERENCE / CUT_AND_FILL winner: SWITCHBACK-k2-p+20-CW-g0.120 -> SPIRAL-n1-CCW-e+0-g0.100, matching the exhaustive winner. Two causes: (1) D-2 pricing ranks the 0-reversal helix (total 3.85, 0.0232 rad/m, 1 hairpin run at the portal approach) above every switchback (best k1 5.05 with 16 reversals, best k2 5.86 with 33); (2) the proxy fix un-starves the spiral the old proxy never validated. Winner length grows 3825 -> 4679 m and minPlanRadius 18 -> 30.5 m; reversals drop 33 -> 0.
explanation.4_stressRecovered: GEOMETRY-STRESS: NO_FEASIBLE_CANDIDATE -> SUCCESS with SWITCHBACK-k1-p+20-CCW-g0.100 (21/21 levels accessed, 27 reversals, total 6.77 vs 6.99 for the CW twin; both k2 stress variants are infeasible). The commit-B starvation finding is thereby resolved by the proxy corrective, not by relaxing any constraint: the winning k1 was itself shortlist-starved under the old proxy (rank 22/26).
explanation.5_k1VsK2: Fair k1/k2 competition (exhaustive table attached): on TABULAR both legs variants are feasible and k1 dominates k2 under the new pricing (16 vs 33 reversals; best totals 5.05 vs 5.86) while the spiral dominates both; on GEOMETRY-STRESS only k1 survives the hard gates. No weight was tuned toward any family.
explanation.6_residualFamilyMiss: Shortlist audit #3 (golden/phase20b1_shortlist_audit.json): missedWinner=False on all 7 cases; missedFamilies=['SWITCHBACK'] persists on TABULAR/CUT_AND_FILL/WARPED-301/IRREGULAR because the family slot validates the family's best CHEAP candidate and stage-4 access feasibility is invisible to any cheap bound: the first detail-feasible switchback sits at family-internal cheap rank 4 (TABULAR) / 2 (301). Widening per-family slots until these cases pass would be outcome-tuning; recorded as a bounded-shortlist limitation (Phase 20C candidate work alongside assignment backtracking).
explanation.7_shortlistCompositionDiffs: All candidateStatuses / shortlist / accessibleLevels / ranking / feasibleCount contract diffs are the NOT_VALIDATED<->validated set change from the proxy reordering plus family slots (e.g. WARPED-301 feasibleCount 4 -> 3: the two detail-feasible k2 switchbacks left the shortlist, a third spiral entered and validates). Stage-4 validation itself is unchanged in commit D.
explanation.8_unchangedCases: WARPED-307 stays NO_FEASIBLE_CANDIDATE (commit-C proven geometry); ACCESS-INFEASIBLE stays 0 feasible by design; WARPED-301 and IRREGULAR keep winner SPIRAL-n1-CCW-e+0-g0.120 and SUCCESS.
